title: Kickstart - Serving Ops Roundtable (prep)
content:
Context:
This is a prep/scratchpad for the weekly Serving Ops roundtable. The focus this week is on three cross-cutting hotspots we flagged during the on-call rotation: cold-start latency spikes, console query-timeout errors, and a proposed small rollout of the prefixed-KV cache change for dedicated pools.

Meeting logistics:
- Who: serving runtime + infra + console leads (eng-serving-runtime, infra, devexp on-call)
- When: weekly sync, Fri 2026-03-13 10:00-10:45 PT (block 45m)
- Where: #serving-roundtable (Zoom link in calendar)
- Pre-reads: SRV-4821 incident timeline (attached), perf snapshot (last 7 days), rollout playbook draft

Agenda (timeboxed):
1) 5m — quick wins and escalations (round-robin)
   - each lead: 30s on high-priority blockers
2) 10m — cold-start latency spikes (obs + hypothesis) — owner: Leila
   - recent pattern: 02:00–03:00 PT daily (saw tail at p99.9, +120ms vs baseline)
   - hypothesis: small cohort of models hitting slow kernel path after mem reclaim; suspect kernel selection fallback
   - data needed: kernel trace + scheduling scatter across GPUs (ask SRE for flamegraph)
3) 12m — console query-timeout regression (telemetry + repro) — owner: Carlos
   - error: QueryTimeout::500 after 8s (was 10s SLA), spike correlates with increased batching in lp-qps window
   - need to confirm if batching heuristic change on 2026-03-05 coincides
   - quick mitigation: throttle batching or lower per-route batch cap for critical routes
4) 10m — prefixed-KV cache rollout (canary plan) — owner: Ibrahim
   - proposal: enable prefixed-KV for 10% dedicated capacity for 48h, auto rollback on tail latency > +50ms
   - checklist: metrics dashboard, canary weight control, fallback variant build, comms to customers on Dedicated
5) 5m — action-item review + next steps — owner: Ibrahim

Pre-read checklist (notes to self):
- Attach perf-snapshot-2026-03-06-12-03.csv (CPU/GPU p50/p95/p99)
- Copy SRV-4821 incident timeline into chat before meeting
- Create quick Grafana playlist link for quick-glance dashboards
- DM SRE to request kernel traces before 11:00 PT

Action items (live tracker / add during meeting):
- AI-01: Collect kernel-selection traces for p99 cold-start cases — assignee: Leila Morgan — due: 2026-03-15 — status: todo
- AI-02: Revert batching heuristic tweak in staging and run AB test — assignee: Carlos Ortiz — due: 2026-03-14 — status: in_progress
- AI-03: Create canary playbook and deploy script for prefixed-KV — assignee: Ibrahim Khan — due: 2026-03-16 — status: todo
- AI-04: Dashboard: add alert for console query-timeout rate >0.5% / 5m — assignee: SRE-oncall (TBD) — due: 2026-03-14 — status: todo
- AI-05: Customer-facing note draft (if rollback needed) — assignee: Leila Morgan + Solutions Eng — due: 2026-03-16 — status: todo

Open questions / parking lot:
- If kernel fallback is root cause, how cheaply can we detect and preemptively recompile/force kernel selection? (Research task)
- Prefixed-KV: do we need per-model tuning to avoid cache thrash in small models?
- Is the console query-timeout regression strictly downstream of batching or also tied to increased RPC retries?

Notes-to-self (scratchy):
- Keep meeting tight; start with hard numbers not anecdotes.
- Bring the 3-minute perf clip to show tail behavior (makes discussion concrete).
- If Leila needs more than 12m, defer other items and schedule deep-dive next week.

Post-meeting follow-up template (to send in thread):
- Summary (1-2 lines): what we saw + root cause hypothesis or immediate mitigation
- Decisions: list of decisions (canary go/no-go, rollback, throttle)
- Action items: list with owners + due dates
- Links: incident ticket, dashboards, PRs/commits

Recent links to paste after meeting:
- Incident: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SRV-4821
- Grafana glance: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/serving/perf-playlist
- PR for prefixed-KV: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/8372

Quick diary: 2026-03-12 18:10 PT — drafted prep. Will finalize tomorrow morning and drop pre-reads in calendar.

End of scratchpad.
